{{Quote|Welcome to the Ancient Abyss; a place of sacrifice, since time immemorial.|Shaak Ti|audio=AncientAbyss-TFU.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ancient Abyss''' was a sacred [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] pit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], the largest known sarlacc specimen in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] city existed between the teeth and gums that stretched four kilometers around its maw.<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> The tendrils of the sarlacc were so large that they were capable of dragging large beasts such as [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] into the creature's mouth.

==History==
The Pit was used as a sacrificial place by the native [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] for many years prior to the arrival of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].

After learning that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], had arrived on Felucia to [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|kill]] her, Shaak Ti made her way to the Ancient Abyss, where she confronted the aspiring [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. During the battle, Shaak Ti's [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] mount was attacked by a tentacle of the giant sarlacc, which forced the beast into its maw, where it was consumed. Shaak Ti attempted to use the massive sarlacc to kill Starkiller; however, she failed, and he defeated her. Wounded, she gave a warning to Starkiller that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] always betrayed one another, before willingly falling into the maw of the sarlacc.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

[[File:ImpSarlaccDentist.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Ancient Abyss placed under Imperial control.]]

Following Shaak Ti's death, Felucia fell into [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]]. Under the influence of [[Maris Brood]], Ti's former apprentice, the Felucian tribes turned into savages. Then the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived and took control of the planet, and began to exterminate the entire Felucian species. Many of the Felucians fled into the sarlacc, so the Empire constructed a stabilizer which held the creature down and allowed passage into its maw, restraining its tendrils and ripping its teeth out.<ref name=":0" />

When Starkiller [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|arrived once again]] to search for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], he sensed the creature's pain and freed it of the chains restraining its tentacles. He proceeded to use the stabilizer lift to search the creature's inside for Organa, before being spewed out of its lung.<ref name=":0" />
